2. **OpenAI announces three AI-made results in math, CS and physics, handed to outside experts to verify**: its internal models produced a proof of the local smoothing conjecture in all dimensions (implying Kakeya and restriction), a Lean-checked refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis via a faster-than-ETH SAT algorithm (not P=NP), and existence proofs for QCD and Yang–Mills (existence only, not the mass gap). It's stateless with no chat mode — your agent owns context and planning — and self-describing via `--help` and `--dry-run`. 880+ bookmarks. https://x.com/_philschmid/status/2114773524787187804 | https://aistudio.google.com/learn/introducing-the-gemini-api-cli
> **[zh]** **Google 发布 Gemini API CLI——给你现有 Agent 用的工具**：把 `gemini-api` 交给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等，就能生成图片、视频、语音和音乐，分析 PDF、音频、视频和 YouTube 链接，转写成 md/json/srt，并在后台跑 Deep Research。它无状态、没有聊天模式——上下文和计划由你的 Agent 掌握——并通过 `--help`、`--dry-run` 自我描述。880+ 收藏。
2. **Matt Pocock's prompt of the day: split a "one-way door" PR into two**: ask the agent for one PR that implements everything but stays easily revertible (a two-way door), plus a stacked follow-up PR that actually goes through the one-way door — expand/contract with feature flags as needed — so you can test most of a huge change in production first. 600+ bookmarks. https://x.com/mattpocockuk/status/2114749427889979405
> **[zh]** **Matt Pocock 今日提示词：把「单向门」PR 拆成两个**：让 Agent 先出一个实现全部功能但随时能回滚的 PR（双向门），再叠一个真正跨过单向门的后续 PR——即 expand/contract，必要时用功能开关——这样巨大的改动大部分可以先在生产环境验证。600+ 收藏。
3. **Vox: have Claude Code write your REVIEW.md from the last 50 commits**: following the Claude Code team's review setup, the prompt mines reverts and bug-fix commits into a short REVIEW.md (what counts as a bug, which nits to skip, paths to ignore, every comment must cite file and line), then adds three AGENTS.md rules: paste test and build output before saying done, have a fresh-context subagent review the diff against REVIEW.md (only new changes from round two), and stop after three review rounds to rethink with you. https://x.com/Voxyz_ai/status/2114839487574315517
> **[zh]** **Vox：让 Claude Code 根据最近 50 个提交写出你的 REVIEW.md**：参照 Claude Code 团队的评审做法，这段提示词从回滚和修 bug 的提交里提炼出一份简短的 REVIEW.md（什么算 bug、哪些小问题跳过、忽略哪些路径、每条评论都要写明文件和行号），再往 AGENTS.md 加三条规则：说完成前先贴测试和构建输出；改完让没看过对话的子 Agent 对照 REVIEW.md 审 diff（第二轮起只看新改动）；最多三轮评审，还不过就停下来和你重新讨论方案。

### 新产品
1. **Hob: a free, MIT-licensed, on-device alternative to the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps**: it works on your files like Claude Cowork but runs open-weight models (Gemma 4, gpt-oss) locally on Mac, Windows and Linux, auto-picks the best model for your hardware, writes sandboxed Python for ad hoc tools, and adds SearXNG web search, MCP connectors, image recognition and local file CRUD; chats and files never leave the machine and it works fully offline. ~112 points on Show HN; commenters said there are "a zillion of these" but upvoted anyway, and asked for a custom model directory and a native rather than Electron app. https://hob.chat [GitHub](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/hob) [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50246238)
> **[zh]** **Hob：免费、MIT 许可、完全本地运行的 Claude / ChatGPT 桌面版替代品**：像 Claude Cowork 一样处理你的文件，但在 Mac、Windows、Linux 上本地跑开放权重模型（Gemma 4、gpt-oss），首次安装自动为你的硬件挑最合适的模型，能写沙箱化 Python 临时造工具，还有 SearXNG 网页搜索、MCP 连接器、图像识别和本地文件增删改查；对话和文件不出本机，可完全离线使用。Show HN 约 112 分；评论说「这类东西已经多如牛毛」但照样点赞，也有人想要自定义模型目录、希望做成原生应用而不是 Electron。
2. **Entire: a Git forge built for agent-human collaboration**: instead of the PR timeline, "Trails" puts agent-scored, customizable evals computed on every push at the top of the page; a new Git-compatible server claims pushes up to 89x faster than GitHub and 6x faster than Cursor Origin with multi-region replication; "Continuous Memory" syncs agent sessions and prompts into the repo (via git refs, per its field CTO) so agents can search them; CI partners are Buildkite and Depot. Available today. On HN one commenter agreed the PR stops being the right review unit when agents write the code, while others found the post too marketing-heavy and asked about pricing. https://entire.com/blog/the-git-forge-for-agent-human-collaboration [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50247453)
> **[zh]** **Entire：为「Agent 与人协作」打造的 Git 托管平台**：用「Trails」取代 PR 时间线，把每次推送后由 Agent 打分、可自定义的评测结果放在页面最上方；新的 Git 兼容服务器号称推送速度最高是 GitHub 的 89 倍、Cursor Origin 的 6 倍，并支持多地域复制；「Continuous Memory」把 Agent 会话和提示词同步进仓库（据其 Field CTO 说是用 git refs 实现），供 Agent 检索；CI 合作方为 Buildkite 和 Depot。今天起开放。HN 上有人认同「Agent 写代码后 PR 不再是合适的评审单位」，也有人嫌文章营销味太重、追问定价。
3. **CorridorKey 2.0: Corridor Digital's neural green/blue-screen keyer, now a plugin for Resolve, Nuke, After Effects, Premiere and Blender**: one-click keys that predict the true color of semi-transparent foreground (the "un-mixing" problem), native 4K+ HDR in floating point, no flicker, any background color, all running locally (Windows + NVIDIA GPUs; standalone app included); used on 400+ VFX shots of Son of a Dungeon. Beta price $49.50 with no subscription until Nov 20. ~184 points on HN; commenters noted the open-source version is free for organizations under $20M revenue and stressed it isn't prompt-based generative AI. https://corridorkey.com/ [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50251127)
> **[zh]** **CorridorKey 2.0：Corridor Digital 的神经网络绿幕/蓝幕抠像工具，推出 Resolve、Nuke、After Effects、Premiere、Blender 插件**：一键抠像，能预测半透明前景的真实颜色（解决「去混色」难题），原生支持 4K 以上 HDR 浮点色深、无闪烁、任意背景色，全部本地运行（Windows + NVIDIA GPU，附独立应用）；《Son of a Dungeon》的 400 多个特效镜头都用它处理。测试期售价 49.5 美元、无订阅，持续到 11 月 20 日。HN 约 184 分；评论指出开源版对年收入低于 2000 万美元的组织免费，并强调它不是靠提示词生成内容的生成式 AI。
4. **Agent-Reach: one CLI that lets your AI agent read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu with zero API fees**: a fast-rising GitHub Trending repo (~746 stars today) aimed at giving coding agents eyes on the wider web without paying for each platform's API. https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach

### 科技新闻
1. **Cloudflare: GLM-5.3 on Workers AI leaked other customers' data across requests — 155 responses affected**: from Aug 27 to Sep 9, prompts longer than 681,280 tokens could get answers containing data from other users' recent requests. The model was deployed with a 1,048,576-token context but the prefill KV cache pool only held 681,280 tokens; in SGLang's disaggregated prefill/decode mode an over-length prompt was swapped for a one-token placeholder instead of being rejected, so the decode node attended over stale cache pages. Reported by Gadi Evron (Knostic) via HackerOne, model pulled within 40 minutes of the incident and restored the same day with a larger pool and a patched engine; no evidence of deliberate exploitation, coordinated disclosure with SGLang. HN praised the RCA, and some wondered whether other providers would even notice such a bug. https://blog.cloudflare.com/kv-cache-exposure-remediation/ [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50252159)
> **[zh]** **Cloudflare：Workers AI 上的 GLM-5.3 出现跨请求数据泄露，共 155 条响应受影响**：8 月 27 日至 9 月 9 日，长度超过 681,280 token 的提示词，可能收到含有其他用户近期请求数据的回答。该模型按 1,048,576 token 上下文部署，但 prefill 端 KV 缓存池只能放 681,280 token；在 SGLang 的 prefill/decode 分离模式下，超长提示词没有被拒绝，而是被换成一个单 token 占位符，导致 decode 节点在残留的旧缓存页上生成回答。问题由 Knostic 的 Gadi Evron 通过 HackerOne 报告，Cloudflare 宣布事故后 40 分钟内下线模型，当天用更大的缓存池和修补后的引擎恢复服务；未发现蓄意利用，与 SGLang 协同披露。HN 称赞这份事故分析，也有人怀疑别的服务商根本不会察觉这种 bug。
2. **Ubicloud: vLLM's new constrained decoding takes tool-call schema accuracy from 92% to 100%**: serving Kimi K2.6 on vLLM 0.28, only 92% of tool calls matched the expected schema — 2 in every 25 failed, and agents then build on nonsense context; vLLM 0.31 exposes constrained decoding as a server-side flag that guarantees schema adherence for newer Kimi and DeepSeek models. The post walks through how tool declarations and calls are tokenized and parsed. An author is answering questions on HN, where one commenter wanted data on how constraining shifts output quality versus a back-off-and-retry approach. https://www.ubicloud.com/blog/fixing-tool-call-accuracy-in-vllm [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50242870)
> **[zh]** **Ubicloud：vLLM 新增的约束解码把工具调用 schema 准确率从 92% 提到 100%**：用 vLLM 0.28 部署 Kimi K2.6 时，只有 92% 的工具调用符合预期 schema——每 25 次就有 2 次失败，Agent 随后会在错误上下文上继续推理；vLLM 0.31 把约束解码做成服务端开关，可保证较新的 Kimi 和 DeepSeek 模型严格遵守 schema。文章还讲解了工具声明和调用如何被 token 化与解析。作者在 HN 答疑，有评论者希望看到约束解码对输出质量的影响，以及与「回退重试」方案的对比数据。
3. **Microsoft publishes the Type Server Protocol (TSP), a JSON-RPC protocol for querying a Python type server**: it answers protocol-version, snapshot, search-path, import-resolution and computed/declared/expected-type queries using LSP data shapes and a `typeServer/` method prefix, with TypeScript interfaces and a JSON schema as the source of truth; now at 0.4.1 with multi-connection negotiation. HN commenters said it should be called the Python Type Server Protocol, read it as a way to split Pylance from Pyright, and lamented it kept UTF-16 positions. https://github.com/microsoft/pylance-release/blob/main/docs/tsp/type-server-protocol.md [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50248371)
> **[zh]** **微软公布类型服务器协议 TSP：一种向 Python 类型服务器查询分析数据的 JSON-RPC 协议**：可查询协议版本、快照、搜索路径、导入解析，以及计算类型/声明类型/期望类型，沿用 LSP 的数据结构，方法前缀为 `typeServer/`，以 TypeScript 接口和 JSON schema 为权威定义；目前版本 0.4.1，新增多连接协商。HN 评论认为它应该叫「Python 类型服务器协议」，把它解读为让 Pylance 与 Pyright 解耦的手段，也有人遗憾它仍沿用 UTF-16 位置编码。
4. **Broadcom arranges a $63B deal with BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley to finance chip purchases for Anthropic through a new special purpose vehicle**: per Bloomberg, another huge off-balance-sheet financing for AI compute, landing right after Anthropic's S-1. https://www.techmeme.com/261026/p47#a261026p47

### AI 热点
1. **宝玉推荐 Manus《用 Manus 改造 Manus》：AI Native 组织一手实践**：联创张涛写团队怎么吃自己的狗粮——研发用 Manus-mono 统一入口+给 AI 看的说明书，一人可写完前后端和移动端（7 人扛 4 个 App）；约一半产品经理能独立把需求做到上线，视频成新 PRD；市场有「数字同事」接任务、主动提醒、还能给系统提需求。9 月人均 AI 开销超 1 万美元，称买的是时间和注意力；人从亲手做到定规则、看证据、做决定。https://x.com/dotey/status/2114929079975563269 | https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/I_hNNAf7LFBf5nJ0rEJHig
> **[en]** **Baoyu recommends Manus’s “Remaking Manus with Manus”: first-hand AI-native org practices**: co-founder Zhang Tao describes dogfooding—eng builds Manus-mono as a unified entry with AI-readable docs so one person can finish web/backend/mobile (7 people run 4 apps); about half of PMs can ship end-to-end, with video as the new PRD; marketing has a “digital colleague” that takes tasks, nudges, and even files feature requests. Sept AI spend topped $10k per person for time and attention; humans move from doing to setting rules, checking evidence, and deciding.
2. **MiniMax 开源自托管 OpenAI Agents API「OpenAgentCore」**：一套 Core、多种 Harness；官方 OpenAI SDK 只改 `OPENAI_BASE_URL`，Session 里可选 Codex / Claude Code / MiniMax Code，模型与沙箱按协议可换。算力可休眠、工作区可留（microsandbox / E2B / Docker / 本机）；Sandbox、文件系统、Harness、模型提供商都走既定协议。作者 saladday 称目标是对外稳定 API、对内随时换 frontier 组件。https://x.com/shao__meng/status/2114919123281117195 | https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/OpenAgentCore
> **[en]** **MiniMax open-sources self-hosted OpenAI Agents API “OpenAgentCore”**: one Core, many harnesses; point the official OpenAI SDK at your `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, pick Codex / Claude Code / MiniMax Code per session, and swap models/sandboxes via protocol. Compute can sleep while workspaces persist (microsandbox / E2B / Docker / local); sandbox, FS, harness, and model providers are all pluggable. Author saladday says the goal is a stable external API with swappable frontier internals.
3. **铁锤人：消费级 4070 Ti SUPER 本地跑通 π0.5 具身仿真**：没买机械臂，厨房在 LIBERO 仿真里；Ubuntu 跑 APXInf 推理、Mac 跑仿真客户端。卡不在官方适配表，靠 Coding Agent 修 Ada/Blackwell 编译引用问题后改 INT8，开炉放摩卡壶任务成功（223 步、调模型 45 次，服务端推理中位约 32 ms）。项目还带面向 Agent 的新模型移植工作流。https://x.com/lxfater/status/2114926643173327086 | https://github.com/RLinf/APXinf-robo
> **[en]** **Hammer: ran π0.5 embodied sim locally on a consumer 4070 Ti SUPER**: no real robot—kitchen in LIBERO; Ubuntu hosts APXInf inference, Mac runs the sim client. The GPU isn’t on the official support list; after a coding agent fixed an Ada/Blackwell build reference and switching to INT8, the stove+moka-pot task succeeded (223 steps, 45 model calls, ~32 ms median server inference). The project also ships an agent-oriented new-model porting workflow.

### 有趣用法和干货
1. **Uncle Bob 开源 ub-mode：给 coding agent 的三段 Clean Code 纪律**：Clean Code 作者把纪律收成 Skills——① First Make it Work（懒惰协议、先定数据形状、先写会失败的测试）；② Then Make it Right（crapper/dryer/mutator 闸门，CRAP<10、消重复、杀变异）；③ Practice（日志、小上下文、小而有序的 commit）。原则来自人，门槛尽量可机器量。https://x.com/shao__meng/status/2114906791175971242 | https://github.com/unclebob/ub-mode
> **[en]** **Uncle Bob open-sources ub-mode: three-stage Clean Code discipline for coding agents**: the Clean Code author packs the habits into Skills—(1) First Make it Work (lazy protocol, shape data first, failing tests first); (2) Then Make it Right (crapper/dryer/mutator gates, CRAP<10, kill duplication and mutants); (3) Practice (logs, small context, small ordered commits). Principles from humans, gates made machine-checkable.
2. **歸藏优化个人 Memory 与多 Agent 协作：Codex + Muse + Grok Bot 分职**：看板登记各 Agent 角色与授权——Codex 管本地采集/同步/仓库工具与日记记忆；Muse 管长期上下文摘要与健康娱乐资讯；Grok Bot 执行 daily-ai-digest；Claude 原计划参与评审现已暂停。任务来自 Issue，版本回报≠在线状态。https://x.com/op7418/status/2114928011569213603
> **[en]** **Guizang tunes personal Memory and multi-agent collab: Codex + Muse + Grok Bot by role**: a dashboard registers each agent’s role and auth—Codex for local collect/sync/repo tools and diary memory; Muse for long-context summaries plus health/entertainment/info; Grok Bot runs daily-ai-digest; Claude (planned for review) is paused. Tasks come from Issues; a version report ≠ online.
3. **Stanford CS 329Z 第 10 课：用 Terminal-Bench 与 Harbor 把 Agent 当可迭代工程**：评测成真相——任务目录约定 instruction.md / task.toml / Dockerfile / solve.sh / test.sh；verifier 与指令 1–1、防 reward hacking、agent 与 verifier 环境隔离。版本语义：改 agent 环境升主版本（整测重跑）、改 verifier 升次版本（可 regrade）、元数据升补丁。https://x.com/shao__meng/status/2114909091101573476
> **[en]** **Stanford CS 329Z lecture 10: treat agents as iterable engineering with Terminal-Bench and Harbor**: evals are the ground truth—task layout instruction.md / task.toml / Dockerfile / solve.sh / test.sh; verifiers 1–1 with instructions, anti-reward-hacking, agent/verifier env isolation. Versioning: agent-env changes bump major (full re-run), verifier changes minor (regrade), metadata patch.
